reference_source: Ke et al. 2015 / Web of Science
interpretation: All three literature reference cases retain a high delayed-recognition geometry in the OpenAlex reconstruction.
Absolute Beauty Coefficient values are systematically higher in these three OpenAlex reconstructions than the published WoS values, with mean relative difference about +13.3%.
Awakening timing is more stable in this small pilot: two of three cases match exactly and all three are within three years.
The sample is too small and selected to support a general cross-database conclusion. The result justifies expanding source-robustness testing.
